Never the slug.\"\"\"\n    title: str\n    topic: str\n    body: str\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n\n    @property\n    def topic_name(self) -> str:\n        return TOPICS[self.topic]\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Post:\n    id: int\n    title: str\n    slug: str\n    body: str\n    topic: str\n    status: Status\n    author_id: int\n    author_nickname: str | None\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n    first_published_at: str | None  # set once, never cleared\n    pending_edit: PendingEdit | None  # at most one, only while published","originalFile":"\"\"\"Content: posts, their slugs, and the post lifecycle.\n\nTopics are a fixed list here, not a table: members cannot add topics.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nimport unicodedata\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom enum import StrEnum\n\nfrom app import db\nfrom app.accounts import User\n\n# Key stored in the database -> the Spanish name readers see, in the fixed order.\nTOPICS = {\n    \"match\": \"Partido\",\n    \"lineup\": \"Alineación\",\n    \"coach\": \"Técnico\",\n    \"signings\": \"Fichajes\",\n    \"fan-club-news\": \"Noticias del club de aficionados\",\n}\n\n\nclass Status(StrEnum):\n    DRAFT = \"draft\"\n    SUBMITTED = \"submitted\"\n    PUBLISHED = \"published\"\n\n\nSTATUS_NAMES = {Status.DRAFT: \"Borrador\", Status.SUBMITTED: \"Enviada\",\n                Status.PUBLISHED: \"Publicada\"}\n\nSLUG_MAX = 80\nSLUG_FALLBACK = \"publicación\"  # for a title with no letters or digits at all\n\n\nclass ContentError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"A refused change; the message is shown to the person as it is.\"\"\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Transition:\n    starts: frozenset[Status]  # the statuses this action may start from\n    leads_to: Status\n    refused: str               # shown when the post's status is not one of `starts`\n\n\n# The post lifecycle (spec #1), one transition per action. Who may take each\n# action is Policy's question; these only say which moves exist.\n\n# Submit: the member hands their finished draft to the leader for checking.\nSUBMIT = Transition(frozenset({Status.DRAFT}), Status.SUBMITTED,\n                    \"Solo se puede enviar un borrador.\")\n# Withdraw: the member takes their submitted post back to keep working on it.\nWITHDRAW = Transition(frozenset({Status.SUBMITTED}), Status.DRAFT,\n                      \"Solo se puede retirar una publicación enviada.\")\n# Publish: readers see it from the next site update on.\nPUBLISH = Transition(frozenset({Status.DRAFT, Status.SUBMITTED}), Status.PUBLISHED,\n                     \"Esta publicación ya está publicada.\")\n# Send back: the leader says no to a submitted post; its member can rework it.\nSEND_BACK = Transition(frozenset({Status.SUBMITTED}), Status.DRAFT,\n                       \"Solo se puede devolver una publicación enviada.\")\n# Unpublish: back to draft; gone from the public site at the next site update.\nUNPUBLISH = Transition(frozenset({Status.PUBLISHED}), Status.DRAFT,\n                       \"Solo se puede despublicar una publicación publicada.\")\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass PostFields:\n    \"\"\"What a person types into the post editor.\"\"\"\n    title: str\n    topic: str\n    body: str\n    slug: str = \"\"\n\n    @property\n    def typed_slug(self) -> str:\n        \"\"\"The slug as typed, NFC-normalized; \"Fichajes\",\n    \"fan-club-news\": \"Noticias del club de aficionados\",\n}\n\n\nclass Status(StrEnum):\n    DRAFT = \"draft\"\n    SUBMITTED = \"submitted\"\n    PUBLISHED = \"published\"\n\n\nSTATUS_NAMES = {Status.DRAFT: \"Borrador\", Status.SUBMITTED: \"Enviada\",\n                Status.PUBLISHED: \"Publicada\"}\n\nSLUG_MAX = 80\nSLUG_FALLBACK = \"publicación\"  # for Who may take each\n# action is Policy's question; these only say which moves exist.\n\n# Submit: the member hands their finished draft to the leader for checking.\nSUBMIT = Transition(frozenset({Status.DRAFT}), Status.SUBMITTED,\n                    \"Solo se puede enviar un borrador.\")\n# Withdraw: the member takes their submitted post back to keep working on it.\nWITHDRAW = Transition(frozenset({Status.SUBMITTED}), Status.DRAFT,\n                      \"Solo se puede retirar una publicación enviada.\")\n# Publish: readers see it from the next site update on.\nPUBLISH = Transition(frozenset({Status.DRAFT, Status.SUBMITTED}), Status.PUBLISHED,\n                     \"Esta publicación ya está publicada.\")\n# Send back: the leader says no to a submitted post; its member can rework it.\nSEND_BACK = Transition(frozenset({Status.SUBMITTED}), Status.DRAFT,\n                       \"Solo se puede devolver una publicación enviada.\")\n# Unpublish: back to draft; gone from the public site at the next site update.\nUNPUBLISH = Transition(frozenset({Status.PUBLISHED}), Status.DRAFT,\n                       \"Solo se puede despublicar una publicación publicada.\")\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass PostFields:\n    \"\"\"What a person types into the post editor.\"\"\"\n    title: str\n    topic: str\n    body: str\n    slug: str = \"\"\n\n    @property\n    def typed_slug(self) -> str:\n        \"\"\"The slug as typed, NFC-normalized; empty when left for the title to make.\"\"\"\n        return unicodedata.normalize(\"NFC\", self.slug.strip())\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass PendingEdit:\n    \"\"\"A member's proposed change to their published post: the published version\n    stays public until the leader approves it or sends it back. The leader edits published posts directly instead (ADR-003).\"\"\"\n    return (not user.is_leader and post.author_id == user.id\n            and post.status == Status.PUBLISHED)\n\n\ndef may_use_editor(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Open this post in the editor and preview it: whoever may save it directly\n    or propose an edit to it.\"\"\"\n    return may_change_post(user, post) or may_propose_edit(user, post)\n\n\ndef may_submit_or_withdraw(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:","originalFile":"\"\"\"Policy: the one place that says what a person may do.\n\nEvery leader-only admin route is named here, and only here. The admin gate\n(`app.web.signed_in_user`) refuses a member on any of them, and the\naccess-control test reads this set, so protecting a new leader-only route means\nadding its name below.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.content import Post, Status\n\nLEADER_ONLY_ROUTES = frozenset({\n    \"users\",           # GET /admin/users: the list of accounts\n    \"publish_post\",    # POST /admin/posts/{id}/publish\n    \"unpublish_post\",  # POST /admin/posts/{id}/unpublish\n    \"send_back_post\",  # POST /admin/posts/{id}/send-back\n})\n\n\ndef may_use_route(user: User, route_name: str | None) -> bool:\n    return user.is_leader or route_name not in LEADER_ONLY_ROUTES\n\n\ndef may_change_post(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Save, preview or delete this post: the leader, any post; a member, only\n    their own drafts (ADR-003).\"\"\"\n    return user.is_leader or (post.author_id == user.id and post.status == Status.DRAFT)\n\n\ndef may_submit_or_withdraw(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Submit this post, or withdraw it: only the member who wrote it. The leader\n    publishes or sends back instead (ADR-003).\"\"\"\n    return not user.is_leader and post.author_id == user.id\n\n\ndef may_publish(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Publish this post: the leader only, and a member's post only once its\n    member has submitted it. The leader's own drafts go straight out (ADR-003).\"\"\"\n    return user.is_leader and (post.author_id == user.id or post.status != Status.DRAFT)\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":28,"oldLines":6,"newStart":28,"newLines":19,"lines":["     return user.is_leader or (post.author_id == user.id and post.status == Status.DRAFT)"," "," ","+def may_propose_edit(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:","+    \"\"\"Propose an edit to this post: only the member who wrote it, once it is","+    published. answered with /login.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass CsrfRejected(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised for a POST without this session's CSRF token; answered with 403.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass Forbidden(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when a signed-in user may not do this; answered with the refusal page,\n    which gives the reason.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, user: User,\n                 reason: str = \"Esta pantalla es solo para el líder del club de aficionados.\",\n                 ) -> None:\n        self.user = user\n        self.reason = reason\n\n\nclass NotFound(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised for an unknown id; answered with a Spanish 404 page.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, user: User) -> None:\n        self.user = user\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The session's CSRF token, created on first use.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not token:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\ntemplates.env.globals[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token\n# Templates ask Policy only to hide buttons; every route checks again.\ntemplates.env.globals[\"may_publish\"] = policy.may_publish\ntemplates.env.globals[\"may_submit_or_withdraw\"] = policy.may_submit_or_withdraw\n\n\nasync def require_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Refuse any POST whose form does not carry this session's CSRF token.\"\"\"\n    if request.method != \"POST\":\n        return\n    sent = (await request.form()).get(\"csrf_token\")\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not (isinstance(sent, str) and expected and secrets.compare_digest(sent, expected)):\n        raise CsrfRejected\n\n\ndef get_db(request: Request) -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\n    conn = db.connect(request.app.state.database_path)\n    try:\n        yield conn\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef signed_in_user(request: Request, conn: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db)) -> User:\n    \"\"\"The user behind this session, reloaded on every request, if this route\n    is one they may use.\"\"\"\n    user = accounts.active_user(conn, request.session.get(\"user_id\"))\n    if user is None:\n        raise LoginRequired\n    route = request.scope.get(\"route\")\n    if not policy.may_use_route(user, getattr(route, \"name\", None)):\n        raise Forbidden(user)\n    return user\n\n\ndef flash(request: Request, message: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Show this message on the next page rendered for this session, once.\"\"\"\n    request.session[\"flash\"] = message\n\n\ndef render(request: Request, name: str, user: User | None = None,\n           status_code: int = 200, **context):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, name, {\"site_title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"user\": user,\n                        \"message\": request.session.pop(\"flash\", None), **context},\n        status_code=status_code,\n    )\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":54,"oldLines":6,"newStart":54,"newLines":8,"lines":[" # Templates ask Policy only to hide buttons; every route checks again."," templates.env.globals[\"may_publish\"] = policy.may_publish"," templates.env.globals[\"may_submit_or_withdraw\"] = policy.may_submit_or_withdraw","+templates.env.globals[\"may_change_post\"] = policy.may_change_post","+templates.env.globals[\"may_propose_edit\"] = policy.may_propose_edit"," "," "," async def require_csrf(request: Request) -> None:"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"65bb02b2-fea3-4ed1-9933-a778ce97cc4f","session_id":"9a7f3e0c-bc89-4928-8487-31a077b3ff91","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"e497858b-2de3-4ec6-844e-b66aa901412e","version":"2.1.292","gitBranch":"main"}

user: User = Depends(signed_in_user),\n                conn: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db)):\n    try:\n        post = content.create_post(conn, user, fields)\n    except content.ContentError                          preview_html=markdown.to_html(fields.body))\n\n\n@router.get(\"/posts/{post_id}\", name=\"post\")\ndef post_page(request: Request, post: Post = Depends(existing_post),\n Puedes cambiarlo hasta que el líder la publique por primera vez; después queda fijo para que los enlaces compartidos sigan funcionando.</p>\n    {% endif %}\n    <label for=\"topic\">Tema</label>\n    <select id=\"topic\" name=\"topic\" required>\n      <option value=\"\">Elige un tema</option>\n      {% for key, name in topics.items() %}\n      <option value=\"{{ key }}\"{% if form.topic == key %} selected{% endif %}>{{ name }}</option>\n      {% endfor %}\n    </select>\n    <label for=\"body\">Texto (Markdown)</label>\n    <textarea id=\"body\" name=\"body\" rows=\"14\">{{ form.body }}</textarea>\n    <div class=\"actions\">\n      <button class=\"primary\" type=\"submit\">{{ \"Guardar borrador\" if not post or post.status == \"draft\" else \"Guardar cambios\" }}</button>\n      <button type=\"submit\" formaction=\"{{ url_for('preview_post', post_id=post.id) if post else url_for('preview_new_post') }}\">Vista previa</button>\n      {% if post %}<a class=\"danger\" href=\"{{ url_for('confirm_delete_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">Borrar</a>{% endif %}\n    </div>\n  </form>\n  {% if post and user.is_leader and post.status == \"published\" %}\n  <form class=\"lifecycle\" method=\"post\" action=\"{{ url_for('unpublish_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <p class=\"help\">Está publicada. Si la despublicas vuelve a ser borrador, y desaparece del sitio público con la próxima actualización del sitio.</p>\n    <button type=\"submit\">Despublicar</button>\n  </form>\n  {% elif post and may_publish(user, post) %}\n  <form class=\"lifecycle\" method=\"post\" action=\"{{ url_for('publish_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <p class=\"help\">Se publica la versión guardada: guarda antes tus cambios. Los lectores la verán después de la próxima actualización del sitio, y desde entonces el enlace queda fijo.</p>\n    <button class=\"primary\" type=\"submit\">Publicar</button>\n  </form>\n  {% if post.status == \"submitted\" %}\n  <form class=\"lifecycle\" method=\"post\" action=\"{{ url_for('send_back_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <p class=\"help\">Si no se puede publicar así, devuélvela: vuelve a ser borrador y quien la escribió puede corregirla y enviarla otra vez.</p>\n    <button type=\"submit\">Devolver a borrador</button>\n  </form>\n  {% endif %}\n  {% elif post and may_submit_or_withdraw(user, post) %}\n  <form class=\"lifecycle\" method=\"post\" action=\"{{ url_for('submit_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <p class=\"help\">Se envía la versión guardada: guarda antes tus cambios. Mientras el líder la revisa no podrás cambiarla; si necesitas corregir algo, retírala.</p>\n    <button class=\"primary\" type=\"submit\">Enviar para revisión</button>\n  </form>\n  {% elif post and user.is_leader %}\n  <p class=\"lifecycle help\">Es el borrador de un miembro: podrás publicarlo cuando quien lo escribió lo envíe para revisión.</p>\n  {% endif %}\n  {% if preview_html is defined %}\n  <section class=\"preview\" aria-label=\"Vista previa\">\n    <h2>Vista previa</h2>\n    <p class=\"help\">Así lo verán los lectores. {"parentUuid":"d192b47d-4621-4192-86f5-d1ebc8208b23","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"a91a41d9-4804-42dc-a2a8-4ff0927b7143","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Nz85b67zS5U4XzGpaRLMMq","type":"tool_result","content":"The file /Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/templates/admin/post_form.html has been updated successfully."}]},"uuid":"2a096742-95a0-49e5-83bb-e47377d15e3e","timestamp":"2026-10-11T16:43:56.177Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/templates/admin/post_form.html","oldString":"      <button class=\"primary\" type=\"submit\">{{ \"Guardar borrador\" if not post or post.status == \"draft\" else \"Guardar cambios\" }}</button>\n      <button type=\"submit\" formaction=\"{{ url_for('preview_post', post_id=post.id) if post else url_for('preview_new_post') }}\">Vista previa</button>\n      {% if post %}<a class=\"danger\" href=\"{{ url_for('confirm_delete_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">Borrar</a>{% endif %}\n    </div>\n  </form>\n  {% if post and user.is_leader and post.status == \"published\" %}","newString":"      <button class=\"primary\" type=\"submit\">\n        {%- if proposing %}Proponer cambios{% elif not post or post.status == \"draft\" %}Guardar borrador{% else %}Guardar cambios{% endif -%}\n      </button>\n      <button type=\"submit\" formaction=\"{{ url_for('preview_post', post_id=post.id) if post else url_for('preview_new_post') }}\">Vista previa</button>\n      {% if post and may_change_post(user, post) %}<a class=\"danger\" href=\"{{ url_for('confirm_delete_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">Borrar</a>{% endif %}\n    </div>\n  </form>\n  {% if proposing %}\n  {# Proposing changes, above, is the member's only action on a published post. #}\n  {% elif post and user.is_leader and post.status == \"published\" %}","originalFile":"{% extends \"admin/base.html\" %}\n{% set heading = post.title if post else \"Nueva publicación\" %}\n{# A member changing their published post proposes an edit; the leader checks it. #}\n{% set proposing = post and may_propose_edit(user, post) %}\n{% block title %}{{ heading }}{% endblock %}\n{% block content %}\n  <h1>{{ heading }}</h1>\n  {% if post %}{% include \"admin/_post_meta.html\" %}{% endif %}\n  {% if proposing %}\n  <p class=\"help\">\n    {%- if post.pending_edit %}Tus cambios propuestos, guardados el {{ post.pending_edit.updated_at | monterrey_time }}, esperan la revisión del líder. Si vuelves a proponer cambios, reemplazan a esos.\n    {%- else %}Está publicada: tus cambios no se publican de inmediato. El líder los revisa y, mientras tanto, los lectores siguen viendo la versión publicada.{% endif -%}\n  </p>\n  {% endif %}\n  {% if error %}<p class=\"error\" role=\"alert\">{{ error }}</p>{% endif %}\n  {% if proposing %}{% set action = url_for('propose_edit', post_id=post.id) %}\n  {% elif post %}{% set action = url_for('save_post', post_id=post.id) %}\n  {% else %}{% set action = url_for('create_post') %}{% endif %}\n  <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ action }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <label for=\"title\">Título</label>\n    <input id=\"title\" name=\"title\" type=\"text\" value=\"{{ form.title }}\" required>\n    <label for=\"slug\">Enlace</label>\n    {% if post and post.slug_locked %}\n    <input id=\"slug\" name=\"slug\" type=\"text\" value=\"{{ post.slug }}\" readonly aria-describedby=\"slug-help\">\n    <p id=\"slug-help\" class=\"help\">Quedó fijo cuando se publicó por primera vez, para que los enlaces compartidos sigan funcionando.</p>\n    {% else %}\n    <input id=\"slug\" name=\"slug\" type=\"text\" value=\"{{ form.slug }}\" placeholder=\"Se crea a partir del título\" aria-describedby=\"slug-help\">\n    <p id=\"slug-help\" class=\"help\">Solo letras minúsculas, números y guiones. Puedes cambiarlo hasta que el líder la publique por primera vez; después queda fijo para que los enlaces compartidos sigan funcionando.</p>\n    {% endif %}\n    <label for=\"topic\">Tema</label>\n    <select id=\"topic\" name=\"topic\" required>\n      <option value=\"\">Elige un tema</option>\n      {% for key, name in topics.items() %}\n      <option value=\"{{ key }}\"{% if form.topic == key %} selected{% endif %}>{{ name }}</option>\n      {% endfor %}\n    </select>\n    <label for=\"body\">Texto (Markdown)</label>\n    <textarea id=\"body\" name=\"body\" rows=\"14\">{{ form.body }}</textarea>\n    <div class=\"actions\">\n      <button class=\"primary\" type=\"submit\">{{ \"Guardar borrador\" if not post or post.status == \"draft\" else \"Guardar cambios\" }}</button>\n      <button type=\"submit\" formaction=\"{{ url_for('preview_post', post_id=post.id) if post else url_for('preview_new_post') }}\">Vista previa</button>\n      {% if post %}<a class=\"danger\" href=\"{{ url_for('confirm_delete_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">Borrar</a>{% endif %}\n    </div>\n  </form>\n  {% if post and user.is_leader and post.status == \"published\" %}\n  <form class=\"lifecycle\" method=\"post\" action=\"{{ url_for('unpublish_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <p class=\"help\">Está publicada. Si la despublicas vuelve a ser borrador, y desaparece del sitio público con la próxima actualización del sitio.</p>\n    <button type=\"submit\">Despublicar</button>\n  </form>\n  {% elif post and may_publish(user, post) %}\n  <form class=\"lifecycle\" method=\"post\" action=\"{{ url_for('publish_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <p class=\"help\">Se publica la versión guardada: guarda antes tus cambios. Los lectores la verán después de la próxima actualización del sitio, y desde entonces el enlace queda fijo.</p>\n    <button class=\"primary\" type=\"submit\">Publicar</button>\n  </form>\n  {% if post.status == \"submitted\" %}\n  <form class=\"lifecycle\" method=\"post\" action=\"{{ url_for('send_back_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <p class=\"help\">Si no se puede publicar así, devuélvela: vuelve a ser borrador y quien la escribió puede corregirla y enviarla otra vez.</p>\n    <button type=\"submit\">Devolver a borrador</button>\n  </form>\n  {% endif %}\n  {% elif post and may_submit_or_withdraw(user, post) %}\n  <form class=\"lifecycle\" method=\"post\" action=\"{{ url_for('submit_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <p class=\"help\">Se envía la versión guardada: guarda antes tus cambios. Mientras el líder la revisa no podrás cambiarla; si necesitas corregir algo, retírala.</p>\n    <button class=\"primary\" type=\"submit\">Enviar para revisión</button>\n  </form>\n  {% elif post and user.is_leader %}\n  <p class=\"lifecycle help\">Es el borrador de un miembro: podrás publicarlo cuando quien lo escribió lo envíe para revisión.</p>\n  {% endif %}\n  {% if preview_html is defined %}\n  <section class=\"preview\" aria-label=\"Vista previa\">\n    <h2>Vista previa</h2>\n    <p class=\"help\">Así lo verán los lectores. Todavía no se ha guardado.</p>\n    <div class=\"preview-body\">{{ preview_html | safe }}</div>\n  </section>\n  {% endif %}\n{% endblock %}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":38,"oldLines":12,"newStart":38,"newLines":16,"lines":["     <label for=\"body\">Texto (Markdown)</label>","     <textarea id=\"body\" name=\"body\" rows=\"14\">{{ form.body }}</textarea>","     <div class=\"actions\">","-      <button class=\"primary\" type=\"submit\">{{ \"Guardar borrador\" if not post or post.status == \"draft\" else \"Guardar cambios\" }}</button>","+      <button class=\"primary\" type=\"submit\">","+        {%- if proposing %}Proponer cambios{% elif not post or post.status == \"draft\" %}Guardar borrador{% else %}Guardar cambios{% endif -%}","+      </button>","       <button type=\"submit\" formaction=\"{{ url_for('preview_post', post_id=post.id) if post else url_for('preview_new_post') }}\">Vista previa</button>","-      {% if post %}<a class=\"danger\" href=\"{{ url_for('confirm_delete_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">Borrar</a>{% endif %}","+      {% if post and may_change_post(user, post) %}<a class=\"danger\" href=\"{{ url_for('confirm_delete_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">Borrar</a>{% endif %}","     </div>","   </form>","-  {% if post and user.is_leader and post.status == \"published\" %}","+  {% if proposing %}","+  {# Proposing changes, above, is the member's only action on a published post. #}","+  {% elif post and user.is_leader and post.status == \"published\" %}","   <form class=\"lifecycle\" method=\"post\" action=\"{{ url_for('unpublish_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">","     <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">","     <p class=\"help\">Está publicada. {"parentUuid":"3fe62596-f945-4f3d-9751-55ca10aa1c0d","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"a91a41d9-4804-42dc-a2a8-4ff0927b7143","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01UwiZErtqLfpZedNKq4YWac","type":"tool_result","content":"The file /Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/policy.py has been updated successfully. (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"17f975ab-410e-421f-9d41-539b6c28b18b","timestamp":"2026-10-11T16:44:54.740Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/policy.py","oldString":"    \"send_back_post\",  # POST /admin/posts/{id}/send-back\n})","newString":"    \"send_back_post\",  # POST /admin/posts/{id}/send-back\n    \"pending_edit\",    # GET  /admin/posts/{id}/pending-edit: published vs proposed\n})","originalFile":"\"\"\"Policy: the one place that says what a person may do.\n\nEvery leader-only admin route is named here, and only here. The admin gate\n(`app.web.signed_in_user`) refuses a member on any of them, and the\naccess-control test reads this set, so protecting a new leader-only route means\nadding its name below.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.content import Post, Status\n\nLEADER_ONLY_ROUTES = frozenset({\n    \"users\",           # GET /admin/users: the list of accounts\n    \"publish_post\",    # POST /admin/posts/{id}/publish\n    \"unpublish_post\",  # POST /admin/posts/{id}/unpublish\n    \"send_back_post\",  # POST /admin/posts/{id}/send-back\n})\n\n\ndef may_use_route(user: User, route_name: str | None) -> bool:\n    return user.is_leader or route_name not in LEADER_ONLY_ROUTES\n\n\ndef may_change_post(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Save, preview or delete this post: the leader, any post; a member, only\n    their own drafts (ADR-003).\"\"\"\n    return user.is_leader or (post.author_id == user.id and post.status == Status.DRAFT)\n\n\ndef may_propose_edit(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Propose an edit to this post: only the member who wrote it, once it is\n    published. The leader edits published posts directly instead (ADR-003).\"\"\"\n    return (not user.is_leader and post.author_id == user.id\n            and post.status == Status.PUBLISHED)\n\n\ndef may_use_editor(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Open this post in the editor and preview it: whoever may save it directly\n    or propose an edit to it.\"\"\"\n    return may_change_post(user, post) or may_propose_edit(user, post)\n\n\ndef may_submit_or_withdraw(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Submit this post, or withdraw it: only the member who wrote it. The leader\n    publishes or sends back instead (ADR-003).\"\"\"\n    return not user.is_leader and post.author_id == user.id\n\n\ndef may_publish(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Publish this post: the leader only, and a member's post only once its\n    member has submitted it. {"parentUuid":"9fd69b3e-a380-4ad7-91c6-fd6b3b15af61","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"a91a41d9-4804-42dc-a2a8-4ff0927b7143","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_019FFFnVB9hmbGTuD7VGPS6e","type":"tool_result","content":"The file /Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/templates/admin/post_form.html has been updated successfully."}]},"uuid":"291cb1c5-c5fa-4064-baa4-ce2473fd54d0","timestamp":"2026-10-11T16:45:05.408Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/templates/admin/post_form.html","oldString":"  {% if post %}{% include \"admin/_post_meta.html\" %}{% endif %}\n  {% if proposing %}","newString":"  {% if post %}{% include \"admin/_post_meta.html\" %}{% endif %}\n  {% if post and user.is_leader and post.pending_edit %}\n  <p class=\"notice\">{{ post.author_nickname or \"—\" }} propuso cambios a esta publicación. Mientras tanto, los lectores siguen viendo la versión publicada.\n    <a href=\"{{ url_for('pending_edit', post_id=post.id) }}\">Revisar cambios propuestos</a></p>\n  {% endif %}\n  {% if proposing %}","originalFile":"{% extends \"admin/base.html\" %}\n{% set heading = post.title if post else \"Nueva publicación\" %}\n{# A member changing their published post proposes an edit; the leader checks it. #}\n{% set proposing = post and may_propose_edit(user, post) %}\n{% block title %}{{ heading }}{% endblock %}\n{% block content %}\n  <h1>{{ heading }}</h1>\n  {% if post %}{% include \"admin/_post_meta.html\" %}{% endif %}\n  {% if proposing %}\n  <p class=\"help\">\n    {%- if post.pending_edit %}Tus cambios propuestos, guardados el {{ post.pending_edit.updated_at | monterrey_time }}, esperan la revisión del líder. Si vuelves a proponer cambios, reemplazan a esos.\n    {%- else %}Está publicada: tus cambios no se publican de inmediato. El líder los revisa y, mientras tanto, los lectores siguen viendo la versión publicada.{% endif -%}\n  </p>\n  {% endif %}\n  {% if error %}<p class=\"error\" role=\"alert\">{{ error }}</p>{% endif %}\n  {% if proposing %}{% set action = url_for('propose_edit', post_id=post.id) %}\n  {% elif post %}{% set action = url_for('save_post', post_id=post.id) %}\n  {% else %}{% set action = url_for('create_post') %}{% endif %}\n  <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ action }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <label for=\"title\">Título</label>\n    <input id=\"title\" name=\"title\" type=\"text\" value=\"{{ form.title }}\" required>\n    <label for=\"slug\">Enlace</label>\n    {% if post and post.slug_locked %}\n    <input id=\"slug\" name=\"slug\" type=\"text\" value=\"{{ post.slug }}\" readonly aria-describedby=\"slug-help\">\n    <p id=\"slug-help\" class=\"help\">Quedó fijo cuando se publicó por primera vez, para que los enlaces compartidos sigan funcionando.</p>\n    {% else %}\n    <input id=\"slug\" name=\"slug\" type=\"text\" value=\"{{ form.slug }}\" placeholder=\"Se crea a partir del título\" aria-describedby=\"slug-help\">\n    <p id=\"slug-help\" class=\"help\">Solo letras minúsculas, números y guiones. Puedes cambiarlo hasta que el líder la publique por primera vez; después queda fijo para que los enlaces compartidos sigan funcionando.</p>\n    {% endif %}\n    <label for=\"topic\">Tema</label>\n    <select id=\"topic\" name=\"topic\" required>\n      <option value=\"\">Elige un tema</option>\n      {% for key, name in topics.items() %}\n      <option value=\"{{ key }}\"{% if form.topic == key %} selected{% endif %}>{{ name }}</option>\n      {% endfor %}\n    </select>\n    <label for=\"body\">Texto (Markdown)</label>\n    <textarea id=\"body\" name=\"body\" rows=\"14\">{{ form.body }}</textarea>\n    <div class=\"actions\">\n      <button class=\"primary\" type=\"submit\">\n        {%- if proposing %}Proponer cambios{% elif not post or post.status == \"draft\" %}Guardar borrador{% else %}Guardar cambios{% endif -%}\n      </button>\n      <button type=\"submit\" formaction=\"{{ url_for('preview_post', post_id=post.id) if post else url_for('preview_new_post') }}\">Vista previa</button>\n      {% if post and may_change_post(user, post) %}<a class=\"danger\" href=\"{{ url_for('confirm_delete_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">Borrar</a>{% endif %}\n    </div>\n  </form>\n  {% if proposing %}\n  {# Proposing changes, above, is the member's only action on a published post. #}\n  {% elif post and user.is_leader and post.status == \"published\" %}\n  <form class=\"lifecycle\" method=\"post\" action=\"{{ url_for('unpublish_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <p class=\"help\">Está publicada. Si la despublicas vuelve a ser borrador, y desaparece del sitio público con la próxima actualización del sitio.</p>\n    <button type=\"submit\">Despublicar</button>\n  </form>\n  {% elif post and may_publish(user, post) %}\n  <form class=\"lifecycle\" method=\"post\" action=\"{{ url_for('publish_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <p class=\"help\">Se publica la versión guardada: guarda antes tus cambios. Los lectores la verán después de la próxima actualización del sitio, y desde entonces el enlace queda fijo.</p>\n    <button class=\"primary\" type=\"submit\">Publicar</button>\n  </form>\n  {% if post.status == \"submitted\" %}\n  <form class=\"lifecycle\" method=\"post\" action=\"{{ url_for('send_back_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <p class=\"help\">Si no se puede publicar así, devuélvela: vuelve a ser borrador y quien la escribió puede corregirla y enviarla otra vez.</p>\n    <button type=\"submit\">Devolver a borrador</button>\n  </form>\n  {% endif %}\n  {% elif post and may_submit_or_withdraw(user, post) %}\n  <form class=\"lifecycle\" method=\"post\" action=\"{{ url_for('submit_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <p class=\"help\">Se envía la versión guardada: guarda antes tus cambios. Mientras el líder la revisa no podrás cambiarla; si necesitas corregir algo, retírala.</p>\n    <button class=\"primary\" type=\"submit\">Enviar para revisión</button>\n  </form>\n  {% elif post and user.is_leader %}\n  <p class=\"lifecycle help\">Es el borrador de un miembro: podrás publicarlo cuando quien lo escribió lo envíe para revisión.</p>\n  {% endif %}\n  {% if preview_html is defined %}\n  <section class=\"preview\" aria-label=\"Vista previa\">\n    <h2>Vista previa</h2>\n    <p class=\"help\">Así lo verán los lectores. Todavía no se ha guardado.</p>\n    <div class=\"preview-body\">{{ preview_html | safe }}</div>\n  </section>\n  {% endif %}\n{% endblock %}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":6,"oldLines":6,"newStart":6,"newLines":10,"lines":[" {% block content %}","   <h1>{{ heading }}</h1>","   {% if post %}{% include \"admin/_post_meta.html\" %}{% endif %}","+  {% if post and user.is_leader and post.pending_edit %}","+  <p class=\"notice\">{{ post.author_nickname or \"—\" }} propuso cambios a esta publicación. Mientras no los revises, los lectores siguen viendo la versión publicada.","originalFile":"{% extends \"admin/base.html\" %}\n{% set heading = post.title if post else \"Nueva publicación\" %}\n{# A member changing their published post proposes an edit; the leader checks it. #}\n{% set proposing = post and may_propose_edit(user, post) %}\n{% block title %}{{ heading }}{% endblock %}\n{% block content %}\n  <h1>{{ heading }}</h1>\n  {% if post %}{% include \"admin/_post_meta.html\" %}{% endif %}\n  {% if post and user.is_leader and post.pending_edit %}\n  <p class=\"notice\">{{ post.author_nickname or \"—\" }} propuso cambios a esta publicación. Mientras tanto, los lectores siguen viendo la versión publicada.\n    <a href=\"{{ url_for('pending_edit', post_id=post.id) }}\">Revisar cambios propuestos</a></p>\n  {% endif %}\n  {% if proposing %}\n  <p class=\"help\">\n    {%- if post.pending_edit %}Tus cambios propuestos, guardados el {{ post.pending_edit.updated_at | monterrey_time }}, esperan la revisión del líder. Si vuelves a proponer cambios, reemplazan a esos.\n    {%- else %}Está publicada: tus cambios no se publican de inmediato. El líder los revisa y, mientras tanto, los lectores siguen viendo la versión publicada.{% endif -%}\n  </p>\n  {% endif %}\n  {% if error %}<p class=\"error\" role=\"alert\">{{ error }}</p>{% endif %}\n  {% if proposing %}{% set action = url_for('propose_edit', post_id=post.id) %}\n  {% elif post %}{% set action = url_for('save_post', post_id=post.id) %}\n  {% else %}{% set action = url_for('create_post') %}{% endif %}\n  <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ action }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <label for=\"title\">Título</label>\n    <input id=\"title\" name=\"title\" type=\"text\" value=\"{{ form.title }}\" required>\n    <label for=\"slug\">Enlace</label>\n    {% if post and post.slug_locked %}\n    <input id=\"slug\" name=\"slug\" type=\"text\" value=\"{{ post.slug }}\" readonly aria-describedby=\"slug-help\">\n    <p id=\"slug-help\" class=\"help\">Quedó fijo cuando se publicó por primera vez, para que los enlaces compartidos sigan funcionando.</p>\n    {% else %}\n    <input id=\"slug\" name=\"slug\" type=\"text\" value=\"{{ form.slug }}\" placeholder=\"Se crea a partir del título\" aria-describedby=\"slug-help\">\n    <p id=\"slug-help\" class=\"help\">Solo letras minúsculas, números y guiones. Puedes cambiarlo hasta que el líder la publique por primera vez; después queda fijo para que los enlaces compartidos sigan funcionando.</p>\n    {% endif %}\n    <label for=\"topic\">Tema</label>\n    <select id=\"topic\" name=\"topic\" required>\n      <option value=\"\">Elige un tema</option>\n      {% for key, name in topics.items() %}\n      <option value=\"{{ key }}\"{% if form.topic == key %} selected{% endif %}>{{ name }}</option>\n      {% endfor %}\n    </select>\n    <label for=\"body\">Texto (Markdown)</label>\n    <textarea id=\"body\" name=\"body\" rows=\"14\">{{ form.body }}</textarea>\n    <div class=\"actions\">\n      <button class=\"primary\" type=\"submit\">\n        {%- if proposing %}Proponer cambios{% elif not post or post.status == \"draft\" %}Guardar borrador{% else %}Guardar cambios{% endif -%}\n      </button>\n      <button type=\"submit\" formaction=\"{{ url_for('preview_post', post_id=post.id) if post else url_for('preview_new_post') }}\">Vista previa</button>\n      {% if post and may_change_post(user, post) %}<a class=\"danger\" href=\"{{ url_for('confirm_delete_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">Borrar</a>{% endif %}\n    </div>\n  </form>\n  {% if proposing %}\n  {# Proposing changes, above, is the member's only action on a published post. #}\n  {% elif post and user.is_leader and post.status == \"published\" %}\n  <form class=\"lifecycle\" method=\"post\" action=\"{{ url_for('unpublish_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <p class=\"help\">Está publicada. Si la despublicas vuelve a ser borrador, y desaparece del sitio público con la próxima actualización del sitio.</p>\n    <button type=\"submit\">Despublicar</button>\n  </form>\n  {% elif post and may_publish(user, post) %}\n  <form class=\"lifecycle\" method=\"post\" action=\"{{ url_for('publish_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <p class=\"help\">Se publica la versión guardada: guarda antes tus cambios. Los lectores la verán después de la próxima actualización del sitio, y desde entonces el enlace queda fijo.</p>\n    <button class=\"primary\" type=\"submit\">Publicar</button>\n  </form>\n  {% if post.status == \"submitted\" %}\n  <form class=\"lifecycle\" method=\"post\" action=\"{{ url_for('send_back_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <p class=\"help\">Si no se puede publicar así, devuélvela: vuelve a ser borrador y quien la escribió puede corregirla y enviarla otra vez.</p>\n    <button type=\"submit\">Devolver a borrador</button>\n  </form>\n  {% endif %}\n  {% elif post and may_submit_or_withdraw(user, post) %}\n  <form class=\"lifecycle\" method=\"post\" action=\"{{ url_for('submit_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <p class=\"help\">Se envía la versión guardada: guarda antes tus cambios. Mientras el líder la revisa no podrás cambiarla; si necesitas corregir algo, retírala.</p>\n    <button class=\"primary\" type=\"submit\">Enviar para revisión</button>\n  </form>\n  {% elif post and user.is_leader %}\n  <p class=\"lifecycle help\">Es el borrador de un miembro: podrás publicarlo cuando quien lo escribió lo envíe para revisión.</p>\n  {% endif %}\n  {% if preview_html is defined %}\n  <section class=\"preview\" aria-label=\"Vista previa\">\n    <h2>Vista previa</h2>\n    <p class=\"help\">Así lo verán los lectores. y el técnico acertó con los cambios.\"}\n\n\ndef every_file_in(site) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Everything the export wrote, as one text.\"\"\"\n    return \"\".join(path.read_text() for path in site.rglob(\"*\") if path.is_file())\n\n\ndef section(html: str, label: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The HTML inside the page's <section> with this aria-label.\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(rf'<section[^>]*aria-label=\"{label}\"[^>]*>(.*?)</section>', html, re.S)\n    assert match, f\"no {label} section\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef review_link(html: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"Where the post page's Revisar cambios propuestos link goes, if it has one.\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(r'<a[^>]*href=\"([^\"]+)\"[^>]*>Revisar cambios propuestos</a>', html)\n    return match.group(1) if match else None\n\n\ndef test_member_saving_changes_to_own_published_post_creates_a_pending_edit_and_the_published_version_is_unchanged_in_console_and_export(\n        client_as, published_post, propose_edit, button_action, cells, export):\n    ana, leader = client_as(\"editor\"), client_as(\"admin\")\n    url = published_post(**PUBLISHED)\n    assert (button_action(ana.get(url).text, \"Proponer cambios\") or \"\").endswith(\n        f\"{url}/propose-edit\")\n\n    response = propose_edit(ana, url, **PROPOSED)\n\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    mine = ana.get(url).text\n    assert \"Cambios enviados al líder\" in mine\n    assert f'value=\"{PROPOSED[\"title\"]}\"' in mine, \"the member picks up her proposal\"\n    assert f'{PROPOSED[\"body\"]}</textarea>' in mine\n    page = leader.get(url).text\n    assert f'value=\"{PUBLISHED[\"title\"]}\"' in page and f'{PUBLISHED[\"body\"]}</textarea>' in page\n    assert [\"Crónica del Clásico Regio\", \"Partido\", \"Rayada de Corazón\", \"Publicada\"] in [\n        row[:4] for row in cells(leader.get(\"/admin/content\").text)]\n    site = export()\n    assert PUBLISHED[\"body\"] in (site / \"posts\" / \"crónica-del-clásico-regio.html\").read_text()\n    assert PROPOSED[\"title\"] not in every_file_in(site)\n    assert PROPOSED[\"body\"] not in f\"{url}/pending-edit\"\n\n    response = leader.get(f\"{url}/pending-edit\")\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"Rayada de Corazón\" in response.text\n    published = The admin gate\n(`app.web.signed_in_user`) refuses a member on any of them, and the\naccess-control test reads this set, so protecting a new leader-only route means\nadding its name below.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.content import Post, Status\n\nLEADER_ONLY_ROUTES = frozenset({\n    \"users\",           # GET /admin/users: the list of accounts\n    \"publish_post\",    # POST /admin/posts/{id}/publish\n    \"unpublish_post\",  # POST /admin/posts/{id}/unpublish\n    \"send_back_post\",  # POST /admin/posts/{id}/send-back\n    \"pending_edit\",    # GET  /admin/posts/{id}/pending-edit: published vs proposed\n})\n\n\ndef may_use_route(user: User, route_name: str | None) -> bool:\n    return user.is_leader or route_name not in LEADER_ONLY_ROUTES\n\n\ndef may_change_post(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Save, preview or delete this post: the leader, any post; a member, only\n    their own drafts (ADR-003).\"\"\"\n    return user.is_leader or (post.author_id == user.id and post.status == Status.DRAFT)\n\n\ndef may_propose_edit(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Propose an edit to this post: only the member who wrote it, once it is\n    published. The leader edits published posts directly instead (ADR-003).\"\"\"\n    return (not user.is_leader and post.author_id == user.id\n            and post.status == Status.PUBLISHED)\n\n\ndef may_use_editor(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Open this post in the editor and preview it: whoever may save it directly\n    or propose an edit to it.\"\"\"\n    return may_change_post(user, post) or may_propose_edit(user, post)\n\n\ndef may_submit_or_withdraw(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Submit this post, or withdraw it: only the member who wrote it. The leader\n    publishes or sends back instead (ADR-003).\"\"\"\n    return not user.is_leader and post.author_id == user.id\n\n\ndef may_publish(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Publish this post: the leader only, and a member's post only once its\n    member has submitted it. The leader's own drafts go straight out (ADR-003).\"\"\"\n    return user.is_leader and (post.author_id == user.id or post.status != Status.DRAFT)\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":16,"oldLines":6,"newStart":16,"newLines":7,"lines":["     \"unpublish_post\",  # POST /admin/posts/{id}/unpublish","     \"send_back_post\",  # POST /admin/posts/{id}/send-back","     \"pending_edit\",    # GET  /admin/posts/{id}/pending-edit: published vs proposed","+    \"approve_edit\",    # POST /admin/posts/{id}/pending-edit/approve"," })"," "," "]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"c9305c47-a858-4d31-ae9c-f971c2c5eb26","session_id":"9a7f3e0c-bc89-4928-8487-31a077b3ff91","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"e497858b-2de3-4ec6-844e-b66aa901412e","version":"2.1.292","gitBranch":"main"}

(file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"438fbd7a-23bb-42d9-9db9-f4fd6a076afd","timestamp":"2026-10-11T16:46:53.738Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/policy.py","oldString":"    \"approve_edit\",    # POST /admin/posts/{id}/pending-edit/approve\n})","newString":"    \"approve_edit\",    # POST /admin/posts/{id}/pending-edit/approve\n    \"send_back_edit\",  # POST /admin/posts/{id}/pending-edit/send-back\n})","originalFile":"\"\"\"Policy: the one place that says what a person may do.\n\nEvery leader-only admin route is named here, and only here. The admin gate\n(`app.web.signed_in_user`) refuses a member on any of them, and the\naccess-control test reads this set, so protecting a new leader-only route means\nadding its name below.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.content import Post, Status\n\nLEADER_ONLY_ROUTES = frozenset({\n    \"users\",           # GET /admin/users: the list of accounts\n    \"publish_post\",    # POST /admin/posts/{id}/publish\n    \"unpublish_post\",  # POST /admin/posts/{id}/unpublish\n    \"send_back_post\",  # POST /admin/posts/{id}/send-back\n    \"pending_edit\",    # GET  /admin/posts/{id}/pending-edit: published vs proposed\n    \"approve_edit\",    # POST /admin/posts/{id}/pending-edit/approve\n})\n\n\ndef may_use_route(user: User, route_name: str | None) -> bool:\n    return user.is_leader or route_name not in LEADER_ONLY_ROUTES\n\n\ndef may_change_post(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Save, preview or delete this post: the leader, any post; a member, only\n    their own drafts (ADR-003).\"\"\"\n    return user.is_leader or (post.author_id == user.id and post.status == Status.DRAFT)\n\n\ndef may_propose_edit(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Propose an edit to this post: only the member who wrote it, once it is\n    published. The leader edits published posts directly instead (ADR-003).\"\"\"\n    return (not user.is_leader and post.author_id == user.id\n            and post.status == Status.PUBLISHED)\n\n\ndef may_use_editor(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Open this post in the editor and preview it: whoever may save it directly\n    or propose an edit to it.\"\"\"\n    return may_change_post(user, post) or may_propose_edit(user, post)\n\n\ndef may_submit_or_withdraw(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Submit this post, or withdraw it: only the member who wrote it. The leader\n    publishes or sends back instead (ADR-003).\"\"\"\n    return not user.is_leader and post.author_id == user.id\n\n\ndef may_publish(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Publish this post: the leader only, and a member's post only once its\n    member has submitted it. The leader's own drafts go straight out (ADR-003).\"\"\"\n    return user.is_leader and (post.author_id == user.id or post.status != Status.DRAFT)\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":17,"oldLines":6,"newStart":17,"newLines":7,"lines":["     \"send_back_post\",  # POST /admin/posts/{id}/send-back","     \"pending_edit\",    # GET  /admin/posts/{id}/pending-edit: published vs proposed","     \"approve_edit\",    # POST /admin/posts/{id}/pending-edit/approve","+    \"send_back_edit\",  # POST /admin/posts/{id}/pending-edit/send-back"," })"," "," "]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"c1fa59a2-e57e-4b26-b913-7a484f8c0e3e","session_id":"9a7f3e0c-bc89-4928-8487-31a077b3ff91","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"e497858b-2de3-4ec6-844e-b66aa901412e","version":"2.1.292","gitBranch":"main"}

Mientras no los revises, los lectores siguen viendo la versión publicada.\n    <a href=\"{{ url_for('pending_edit', post_id=post.id) }}\">Revisar cambios propuestos</a></p>\n  {% endif %}\n  {% if proposing %}\n  <p class=\"help\">\n    {%- if post.pending_edit %}Tus cambios propuestos, guardados el {{ post.pending_edit.updated_at | monterrey_time }}, esperan la revisión del líder. Si vuelves a proponer cambios, reemplazan a esos.\n    {%- else %}Está publicada: tus cambios no se publican de inmediato. El líder los revisa y, mientras tanto, los lectores siguen viendo la versión publicada.{% endif -%}\n  </p>\n  {% endif %}\n  {% if error %}<p class=\"error\" role=\"alert\">{{ error }}</p>{% endif %}\n  {% if proposing %}{% set action = url_for('propose_edit', post_id=post.id) %}\n  {% elif post %}{% set action = url_for('save_post', post_id=post.id) %}\n  {% else %}{% set action = url_for('create_post') %}{% endif %}\n  <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ action }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <label for=\"title\">Título</label>\n    <input id=\"title\" name=\"title\" type=\"text\" value=\"{{ form.title }}\" required>\n    <label for=\"slug\">Enlace</label>\n    {% if post and post.slug_locked %}\n    <input id=\"slug\" name=\"slug\" type=\"text\" value=\"{{ post.slug }}\" readonly aria-describedby=\"slug-help\">\n    <p id=\"slug-help\" class=\"help\">Quedó fijo cuando se publicó por primera vez, para que los enlaces compartidos sigan funcionando.</p>\n    {% else %}\n    <input id=\"slug\" name=\"slug\" type=\"text\" value=\"{{ form.slug }}\" placeholder=\"Se crea a partir del título\" aria-describedby=\"slug-help\">\n    <p id=\"slug-help\" class=\"help\">Solo letras minúsculas, números y guiones. Puedes cambiarlo hasta que el líder la publique por primera vez; después queda fijo para que los enlaces compartidos sigan funcionando.</p>\n    {% endif %}\n    <label for=\"topic\">Tema</label>\n    <select id=\"topic\" name=\"topic\" required>\n      <option value=\"\">Elige un tema</option>\n      {% for key, name in topics.items() %}\n      <option value=\"{{ key }}\"{% if form.topic == key %} selected{% endif %}>{{ name }}</option>\n      {% endfor %}\n    </select>\n    <label for=\"body\">Texto (Markdown)</label>\n    <textarea id=\"body\" name=\"body\" rows=\"14\">{{ form.body }}</textarea>\n    <div class=\"actions\">\n      <button class=\"primary\" type=\"submit\">\n        {%- if proposing %}Proponer cambios{% elif not post or post.status == \"draft\" %}Guardar borrador{% else %}Guardar cambios{% endif -%}\n      </button>\n      <button type=\"submit\" formaction=\"{{ url_for('preview_post', post_id=post.id) if post else url_for('preview_new_post') }}\">Vista previa</button>\n      {% if post and may_change_post(user, post) %}<a class=\"danger\" href=\"{{ url_for('confirm_delete_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">Borrar</a>{% endif %}\n    </div>\n  </form>\n  {% if proposing %}\n  {# Proposing changes, above, is the member's only action on a published post. #}\n  {% elif post and user.is_leader and post.status == \"published\" %}\n  <form class=\"lifecycle\" method=\"post\" action=\"{{ url_for('unpublish_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <p class=\"help\">Está publicada. Si la despublicas vuelve a ser borrador, y desaparece del sitio público con la próxima actualización del sitio.</p>\n    <button type=\"submit\">Despublicar</button>\n  </form>\n  {% elif post and may_publish(user, post) %}\n  <form class=\"lifecycle\" method=\"post\" action=\"{{ url_for('publish_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <p class=\"help\">Se publica la versión guardada: guarda antes tus cambios. Los lectores la verán después de la próxima actualización del sitio, y desde entonces el enlace queda fijo.</p>\n    <button class=\"primary\" type=\"submit\">Publicar</button>\n  </form>\n  {% if post.status == \"submitted\" %}\n  <form class=\"lifecycle\" method=\"post\" action=\"{{ url_for('send_back_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <p class=\"help\">Si no se puede publicar así, devuélvela: vuelve a ser borrador y quien la escribió puede corregirla y enviarla otra vez.</p>\n    <button type=\"submit\">Devolver a borrador</button>\n  </form>\n  {% endif %}\n  {% elif post and may_submit_or_withdraw(user, post) %}\n  <form class=\"lifecycle\" method=\"post\" action=\"{{ url_for('submit_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <p class=\"help\">Se envía la versión guardada: guarda antes tus cambios. Mientras el líder la revisa no podrás cambiarla; si necesitas corregir algo, retírala.</p>\n    <button class=\"primary\" type=\"submit\">Enviar para revisión</button>\n  </form>\n  {% elif post and user.is_leader %}\n  <p class=\"lifecycle help\">Es el borrador de un miembro: podrás publicarlo cuando quien lo escribió lo envíe para revisión.</p>\n  {% endif %}\n  {% if preview_html is defined %}\n  <section class=\"preview\" aria-label=\"Vista previa\">\n    <h2>Vista previa</h2>\n    <p class=\"help\">Así lo verán los lectores. Rayada de Corazón has also proposed changes to her published lineup\npost: the *Cambios propuestos* count on the *Panel* opens it, and the leader compares the two\nversions side by side before approving or sending them back.","originalFile":"# IPHS 400 — Mini-Project #2 starter (Web CMS)\n\nClick **Use this template** → name your repo **`iphs400-mp2-cms`** → make it **Public**.\nDo not fork: a fork arrives without an Issues tab, and your tickets live in Issues.\n\n## Start here\n\n1. `docs/manual_iphs400_mp2-web-cms_20260922.md` — the manual. Read Part 0 and Part 1 first.\n2. `docs/mp2-grading-rubric_20260922.md` — how you are graded. Read it **before** you build.\n3. `docs/mp2-setup_context-threshold-hook_20260922.md` — Exercise A, in Part 4 of the manual.\n\n## Run it\n\n```bash\nuv sync\ncp .env.example .env                  # optional: without it, .env.example is used\nuv run python scripts/seed_demo.py    # wipes and rebuilds cms.db with demo accounts\nuv run cms serve                      # then open http://localhost:8000/admin\nuv run cms publish                    # export the public site to site/ from published posts\npython3 -m http.server -d site 8001   # preview it at http://localhost:8001\nuv run cms deploy                     # put site/ online (the gh-pages branch)\n```\n\nDemo accounts (all fictional; passwords are the values in `.env`):\n\n| Email | Role | Nickname | Password |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| `lider@albiazul.example` | leader (admin) | El Capi | `CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD` |\n| `ana@albiazul.example` | member (editor) | Rayada de Corazón | `CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD` |\n| `beto@albiazul.example` | member (editor) | Furia del Cerro | `CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD` |\n\nThe seed also adds one draft post written by Rayada de Corazón (open *Publicaciones*), one\npost by Furia del Cerro waiting for the leader's review (the *Esperando revisión* count on the\nleader's *Panel*), and one published post in each of the five topics, so the exported site has\nsomething in every section.\n\n## What is here\n\n```text\n.claude/hooks/     the context meter and usage ledger (Exercise A lives in ctx_guard.py)\nscripts/           usage_report.py (Exercise B lives in spend()), check_submission.py, seed_demo.py\ntests/             the exercise tests, plus helpers such as client_as(\"editor\")\napp/, templates/   the T00 skeleton — every CMS feature is yours to build\ndocs/adr/          two example decision records\n```\n\nTwo functions are deliberately unfinished and their tests fail until you write them:\n`decide()` in `.claude/hooks/ctx_guard.py` and `spend()` in `scripts/usage_report.py`.\nBoth are graded. Use `/tdd`, as the manual says.\n\n## Deadlines\n\nStage 1 (`mp2-mvp` tag): Tue Sep 29, 2:40 pm Eastern (soft target).\nStage 2 (`mp2-final` tag): Tue Oct 6, 2:40 pm Eastern, grace until Wed Oct 7, 2:40 pm.\n\nRun `uv run python scripts/check_submission.py --stage 2` before you submit.\n\n## Generative AI Use Statement\n\n*(Required. {"parentUuid":"5c6ae831-544b-4e95-9db0-287aa0dd9bda","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"a91a41d9-4804-42dc-a2a8-4ff0927b7143","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/maximo/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/mattpocock-skills/1.2.3/skills/engineering/code-review\n\nTwo-axis review of the diff between `HEAD` and a fixed point the user supplies:\n\n- **Standards**: does the code conform to this repo's documented coding standards?\n- **Spec**: does the code faithfully implement the originating issue / spec?\n\nBoth axes run as **parallel sub-agents** so they don't pollute each other's context, then this skill aggregates their findings.\n\nThe issue tracker should have been provided to you. If `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md` is missing, tell the user to run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills`.\n\n## Process\n\n### 1. Pin the fixed point\n\nWhatever the user said is the fixed point (a commit SHA, branch name, tag, `main`, `HEAD~5`, etc.). If they didn't specify one, ask for it.\n\nCapture the diff command once: `git diff <fixed-point>...HEAD` (three-dot, so the comparison is against the merge-base). Also note the list of commits via `git log <fixed-point>..HEAD --oneline`.\n\nBefore going further, confirm the fixed point resolves (`git rev-parse <fixed-point>`) and the diff is non-empty. A bad ref or empty diff should fail here, not inside two parallel sub-agents.\n\n### 2. Identify the spec source\n\nLook for the originating spec, in this order:\n\n1. Issue references in the commit messages (`#123`, `Closes #45`, GitLab `!67`, etc.), fetched via the workflow in `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`.\n2. A path the user passed as an argument.\n3. A spec file under `docs/`, `specs/`, or `.scratch/` matching the branch name or feature.\n4. If nothing is found, ask the user where the spec is. If they say there isn't one, the **Spec** sub-agent will skip and report \"no spec available\".\n\n### 3. Identify the standards sources\n\nAnything in the repo that documents how code should be written, such as `CODING_STANDARDS.md` or `CONTRIBUTING.md`.\n\nOn top of whatever the repo documents, the Standards axis always carries the **smell baseline** below: a fixed set of Fowler code smells (_Refactoring_, ch.3) that applies even when a repo documents nothing. Two rules bind it:\n\n- **The repo overrides.** A documented repo standard always wins; where it endorses something the baseline would flag, suppress the smell.\n- **Always a judgement call.** Each smell is a labelled heuristic (\"possible Feature Envy\"), never a hard violation. Like any standard here, skip anything tooling already enforces.\n\nEach smell reads *what it is* → *how to fix*; match it against the diff:\n\n- **Mysterious Name**: a function, variable, or type whose name doesn't reveal what it does or holds. → rename it; if no honest name comes, the design's murky.\n- **Duplicated Code**: the same logic shape appears in more than one hunk or file in the change. → extract the shared shape, call it from both.\n- **Feature Envy**: a method that reaches into another object's data more than its own. → move the method onto the data it envies.\n- **Data Clumps**: the same few fields or params keep travelling together (a type wanting to be born). → bundle them into one type, pass that.\n- **Primitive Obsession**: a primitive or string standing in for a domain concept that deserves its own type. → give the concept its own small type.\n- **Repeated Switches**: the same `switch`/`if`-cascade on the same type recurs across the change. → replace with polymorphism, or one map both sites share.\n- **Shotgun Surgery**: one logical change forces scattered edits across many files in the diff. → gather what changes together into one module.\n- **Divergent Change**: one file or module is edited for several unrelated reasons. → split so each module changes for one reason.\n- **Speculative Generality**: abstraction, parameters, or hooks added for needs the spec doesn't have. → delete it; inline back until a real need shows.\n- **Message Chains**: long `a.b().c().d()` navigation the caller shouldn't depend on. → hide the walk behind one method on the first object.\n- **Middle Man**: a class or function that mostly just delegates onward. → cut it, call the real target direct.\n- **Refused Bequest**: a subclass or implementer that ignores or overrides most of what it inherits. → drop the inheritance, use composition.\n\n### 4. Spawn both sub-agents in parallel\n\n**Standards sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The full diff command and commit list.\n- The list of standards-source files you found in step 3, **plus the smell baseline from step 3** pasted in full (the sub-agent has no other access to it).\n- The brief: \"Report, per file/hunk where relevant, (a) every place the diff violates a documented standard: cite the standard (file + the rule); and (b) any baseline smell you spot: name it and quote the hunk. Distinguish hard violations from judgement calls: documented-standard breaches can be hard, but baseline smells are always judgement calls, and a documented repo standard overrides the baseline. Skip anything tooling enforces. Under 400 words.\"\n\n**Spec sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The diff command and commit list.\n- The path or fetched contents of the spec.\n- The brief: \"Report: (a) requirements the spec asked for that are missing or partial; (b) behaviour in the diff that wasn't asked for (scope creep); (c) requirements that look implemented but where the implementation looks wrong. Quote the spec line for each finding. Under 400 words.\"\n\nIf the spec is missing, skip the Spec sub-agent and note this in the final report.\n\n### 5. Aggregate\n\nPresent the two reports under `## Standards` and `## Spec` headings, verbatim or lightly cleaned. Do **not** merge or rerank findings, because the two axes are deliberately separate (see _Why two axes_).\n\nEnd with a one-line summary: total findings per axis, and the worst issue _within each axis_ (if any). Don't pick a single winner across axes: that's the reranking the separation exists to prevent.\n\n## Why two axes\n\nA change can pass one axis and fail the other:\n\n- Code that follows every standard but implements the wrong thing → **Standards pass, Spec fail.**\n- Code that does exactly what the issue asked but breaks the project's conventions → **Spec pass, Standards fail.**\n\nReporting them separately stops one axis from masking the other.\n\n\nARGUMENTS: Review uncommitted T05 work since HEAD (8c8271c) against ticket #6 (spec #1). Ignore unrelated working-tree changes in .gitignore, notes/, docs/transcripts/."}]},"isMeta":true,"turnCompanion":true,"uuid":"4008d005-114d-4dbe-95e9-120524112021","timestamp":"2026-10-11T16:51:32.587Z","sourceToolUseID":"toolu_01Xhap54UjaKfEWfn8kWf9s2","session_id":"9a7f3e0c-bc89-4928-8487-31a077b3ff91","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"e497858b-2de3-4ec6-844e-b66aa901412e","version":"2.1.292","gitBranch":"main"}

A Post carries its pending edit and\n  its edited-after-publishing time (edited_at).\n- Content: propose_edit creates or replaces the pending edit (title, topic,\n  body; a different slug is refused, the slug stays locked). approve_edit\n  replaces the published title, topic and body and sets edited_at;\n  send_back_edit throws the pending edit away. UNPUBLISH is refused while a\n  pending edit waits. The leader's direct save of a published post sets\n  edited_at.\n- Policy: may_propose_edit (the member who wrote it, once published) and\n  may_use_editor (save directly or propose). pending_edit, approve_edit and\n  send_back_edit are declared leader-only, so the access-control and CSRF\n  tests cover them.\n- Post page: a member's own published post opens the editor with\n  Proponer cambios, picking up their pending edit. The leader sees a notice\n  linking to Revisar cambios propuestos, and no Despublicar button while a\n  pending edit waits.\n- Review screen: the published version and the pending edit side by side,\n  each sanitized as readers see it, with Aprobar cambios and Devolver los\n  cambios.\n- Public post page: Publicado el … · Actualizado el … when edited after\n  publishing.\n- Dashboard counts Cambios propuestos, linking to the content list filtered\n  to posts with a pending edit (new pending filter).\n- Seed adds a pending edit to Rayada de Corazón's published lineup post.\n  CONTEXT.md gives Pending edit, Approve and Send back their Spanish names;\n  README mentions the demo pending edit.\n- Tests: T02's \"member can only read own published post\" now covers the\n  submitted case only (members propose edits once published); T04's\n  dashboard expectations include the new count.\n\nCode review findings and resolutions are on #6.\n\nCo-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>\n\nCloses #6\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":91,"cache_read_input_tokens":226969,"output_tokens":1229,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":274},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":91,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1229,"cache_read_input_tokens":226969,"cache_creation_input_tokens":91,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":91},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_019ZrNimKJ3FLxoCMzuYbs5b":{"file_path":"/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-maximo-code-iphs400-mp2-cms/e497858b-2de3-4ec6-844e-b66aa901412e/scratchpad/t05-commit-msg.txt","content":"T05: Members propose edits to published posts; The leader's direct save of a published post sets\n  edited_at.\n- Policy: may_propose_edit (the member who wrote it, once published) and\n  may_use_editor (save directly or propose). pending_edit, approve_edit and\n  send_back_edit are declared leader-only, so the access-control and CSRF\n  tests cover them.\n- Post page: a member's own published post opens the editor with\n  Proponer cambios, picking up their pending edit. The leader sees a notice\n  linking to Revisar cambios propuestos, and no Despublicar button while a\n  pending edit waits.\n- Review screen: the published version and the pending edit side by side,\n  each sanitized as readers see it, with Aprobar cambios and Devolver los\n  cambios.\n- Public post page: Publicado el … · Actualizado el … when edited after\n  publishing.\n- Dashboard counts Cambios propuestos, linking to the content list filtered\n  to posts with a pending edit (new pending filter).\n- Seed adds a pending edit to Rayada de Corazón's published lineup post.\n  CONTEXT.md gives Pending edit, Approve and Send back their Spanish names;\n  README mentions the demo pending edit.\n- Tests: T02's \"member can only read own published post\" now covers the\n  submitted case only (members propose edits once published); T04's\n  dashboard expectations include the new count.\n\nCode review findings and resolutions are on #6.\n\nCo-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>\n\nCloses #6\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"a43942da-3569-4efd-b457-c07ab6edd504","session_id":"9a7f3e0c-bc89-4928-8487-31a077b3ff91","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"e497858b-2de3-4ec6-844e-b66aa901412e","version":"2.1.292","gitBranch":"main"}

The user can send it another message and resume it, so the same task-id may notify more than once.</note>\n<result>I found nothing missing and no material scope creep. All 11 acceptance criteria of #6 are implemented, and each one maps to a test whose name says which criterion it covers. The full suite passes (148 tests). The findings below are edge cases and small notes.\n\n**(a) Missing or partial**\n\nNone. The lifecycle rows for Propose edit, Approve, Send back (pending edit), Unpublish, Edit directly and Delete are all handled and tested. So are the data model (\"at most one per post\", via a primary key on the post id, so deleting the post deletes the edit), the `pending` filter, the leader-only `/pending-edit` page and the seed. The new routes are picked up automatically by the existing leader-only and CSRF tests.\n\n**(b) Not asked for**\n\n- **P1** Members can now use *Vista previa* on a change they are proposing, which widens the preview route. There is an extra test for it. It is a natural reading of \"an editor with a *Vista previa*\", so it is acceptable.\n- **P2** Small extras: the read-only help text in `post_view.html` is reworded, the *Borrar* link is hidden from a member proposing changes, and `CONTEXT.md` gains Spanish labels (*Devolver*, *Cambios propuestos*, *Aprobar*). The glossary update is allowed by the project's CLAUDE.md.\n\n**(c) Implemented but questionable**\n\n- **P3** If the leader edits a published post directly while a pending edit waits, the pending edit stays. Approving it later copies the member's older title, topic and body over the leader's fix without warning. The spec only says \"*Approve* replaces title, topic and body\" and is silent on this case. The side-by-side page does show the leader's version next to the proposal, so the leader can see it. This is a question for you, not a contract breach.\n- **P4** Edits made after a post is unpublished do not update the \"edited after publishing\" timestamp (`edited_at`). After republishing, readers see the old *Actualizado el …* date. That follows \"Edit directly … if published, sets edited-after-publishing\" to the letter, but conflicts with story 53 (\"*Actualizado el …* if it changed after publishing\"). Unpublishing belongs to an earlier ticket, so this is a note only.\n- **P5** `tests/test_t02_posts.py::test_member_can_only_read_their_own_post_once_it_is_not_a_draft` was narrowed to `..._once_it_is_submitted`. The \"member editing a published post is refused\" case (from the spec's Lifecycle testing note) now lives only in the T05 member-403 test. Coverage is kept, but T02's traceability changed.\n- **P6** If an approve or send-back is refused, the 400 response shows the post editor rather than the side-by-side page. Cosmetic.\n\n**Traceability** (every test is in `tests/test_t05_pending_edits.py` unless noted)\n\n| AC | Test |\n|---|---|\n| 1 | `test_member_saving_changes_to_own_published_post_creates_a_pending_edit_and_the_published_version_is_unchanged_in_console_and_export` |\n| 2 | `test_member_saving_again_replaces_the_pending_edit_so_a_post_has_at_most_one` |\n| 3 | `test_a_pending_edit_never_changes_the_slug` |\n| 4 | `test_leader_sees_..._side_by_side_...` and `test_leader_approves_..._next_export_shows_actualizado_el` |\n| 5 | `test_leader_sends_back_the_pending_edit_and_the_published_version_stays_untouched` |\n| 6 | `test_unpublishing_a_post_with_a_pending_edit_is_refused_with_a_message` |\n| 7 | `test_leaders_direct_edit_of_a_published_post_..._edited_after_publishing` |\n| 8 | `test_members_cannot_approve_send_back_or_propose_edits_..._403` |\n| 9 | `test_pending_edits_never_appear_in_the_export_...` and `test_deleting_a_post_deletes_its_pending_edit` |\n| 10 | `test_dashboard_counts_pending_edits_...` and `test_content_list_filters_to_posts_with_a_pending_edit_...` (both in `tests/test_t05_dashboard.py`) |\n| 11 | `test_seed_adds_one_published_post_with_a_pending_edit_...` (in `tests/test_t05_seed.py`) |\n\nThe relevant code is in `app/content.py` (`propose_edit`, `approve_edit`, `save_post`) and `app/routes/posts.py`.</result>\n<usage><subagent_tokens>94973</subagent_tokens><tool_uses>9</tool_uses><duration_ms>151779</duration_ms></usage>\n</task-notification>"}

The user can send it another message and resume it, so the same task-id may notify more than once.</note>\n<result>I found nothing missing and no material scope creep. All 11 acceptance criteria of #6 are implemented, and each one maps to a test whose name says which criterion it covers. The full suite passes (148 tests). The findings below are edge cases and small notes.\n\n**(a) Missing or partial**\n\nNone. The lifecycle rows for Propose edit, Approve, Send back (pending edit), Unpublish, Edit directly and Delete are all handled and tested. So are the data model (\"at most one per post\", via a primary key on the post id, so deleting the post deletes the edit), the `pending` filter, the leader-only `/pending-edit` page and the seed. The new routes are picked up automatically by the existing leader-only and CSRF tests.\n\n**(b) Not asked for**\n\n- **P1** Members can now use *Vista previa* on a change they are proposing, which widens the preview route. There is an extra test for it. It is a natural reading of \"an editor with a *Vista previa*\", so it is acceptable.\n- **P2** Small extras: the read-only help text in `post_view.html` is reworded, the *Borrar* link is hidden from a member proposing changes, and `CONTEXT.md` gains Spanish labels (*Devolver*, *Cambios propuestos*, *Aprobar*). The glossary update is allowed by the project's CLAUDE.md.\n\n**(c) Implemented but questionable**\n\n- **P3** If the leader edits a published post directly while a pending edit waits, the pending edit stays. Approving it later copies the member's older title, topic and body over the leader's fix without warning. The spec only says \"*Approve* replaces title, topic and body\" and is silent on this case. The side-by-side page does show the leader's version next to the proposal, so the leader can see it. This is a question for you, not a contract breach.\n- **P4** Edits made after a post is unpublished do not update the \"edited after publishing\" timestamp (`edited_at`). After republishing, readers see the old *Actualizado el …* date. That follows \"Edit directly … if published, sets edited-after-publishing\" to the letter, but conflicts with story 53 (\"*Actualizado el …* if it changed after publishing\"). Unpublishing belongs to an earlier ticket, so this is a note only.\n- **P5** `tests/test_t02_posts.py::test_member_can_only_read_their_own_post_once_it_is_not_a_draft` was narrowed to `..._once_it_is_submitted`. The \"member editing a published post is refused\" case (from the spec's Lifecycle testing note) now lives only in the T05 member-403 test. Coverage is kept, but T02's traceability changed.\n- **P6** If an approve or send-back is refused, the 400 response shows the post editor rather than the side-by-side page. Cosmetic.\n\n**Traceability** (every test is in `tests/test_t05_pending_edits.py` unless noted)\n\n| AC | Test |\n|---|---|\n| 1 | `test_member_saving_changes_to_own_published_post_creates_a_pending_edit_and_the_published_version_is_unchanged_in_console_and_export` |\n| 2 | `test_member_saving_again_replaces_the_pending_edit_so_a_post_has_at_most_one` |\n| 3 | `test_a_pending_edit_never_changes_the_slug` |\n| 4 | `test_leader_sees_..._side_by_side_...` and `test_leader_approves_..._next_export_shows_actualizado_el` |\n| 5 | `test_leader_sends_back_the_pending_edit_and_the_published_version_stays_untouched` |\n| 6 | `test_unpublishing_a_post_with_a_pending_edit_is_refused_with_a_message` |\n| 7 | `test_leaders_direct_edit_of_a_published_post_..._edited_after_publishing` |\n| 8 | `test_members_cannot_approve_send_back_or_propose_edits_..._403` |\n| 9 | `test_pending_edits_never_appear_in_the_export_...` and `test_deleting_a_post_deletes_its_pending_edit` |\n| 10 | `test_dashboard_counts_pending_edits_...` and `test_content_list_filters_to_posts_with_a_pending_edit_...` (both in `tests/test_t05_dashboard.py`) |\n| 11 | `test_seed_adds_one_published_post_with_a_pending_edit_...` (in `tests/test_t05_seed.py`) |\n\nThe relevant code is in `app/content.py` (`propose_edit`, `approve_edit`, `save_post`) and `app/routes/posts.py`.</result>\n<usage><subagent_tokens>94973</subagent_tokens><tool_uses>9</tool_uses><duration_ms>151779</duration_ms></usage>\n</task-notification>","reason":"absorbed_mid_turn","commandUuid":"1592f93d-c1d8-4800-b316-34312bc0ade7","deliveryId":"52f6a6d5-1df1-4b49-9c69-6432dd11e3ff"}
