{"parentUuid":"d9aa3908-8c69-4ba3-96aa-a0f32a42ace4","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfvoQJkuXYSPuuRqQqZvT","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01A92XhKVqdYKLrgN6J4Ydry","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-maximo-code-iphs400-mp2-cms/e497858b-2de3-4ec6-844e-b66aa901412e/scratchpad/t05-review-comment.md","content":"## `/code-review` of T05 (uncommitted work on top of 8c8271c)\n\nTwo parallel reviewers: **Standards** (CLAUDE.md, CONTEXT.md, ADRs, SECURITY-CHECKLIST.md plus the smell baseline) and **Spec** (this ticket and spec #1). After the fixes below: `uv run pytest`: **148 passed**. mypy: no issues.\n\n### Standards: 0 hard violations, 11 judgement calls\n\nAll hard constraints pass:\n- **CSRF:** a token on every new form, and the app-wide check covers the new routes.\n- **Markdown:** both versions on the review screen are sanitized.\n- **Export:** no new paths, and it reads only the published columns.\n- **Dependencies:** none added.\n- **Access:** the new leader-only routes are declared in `LEADER_ONLY_ROUTES`.\n\n| # | Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|---|\n| S1 | The filter has three names (`pending`, `only_pending`, `pending_edit: bool`). The last one clashes with `Post.pending_edit`. | **Fixed.** The flag is now `with_pending_edit` in `list_posts` and the route. The `?pending=1` URL parameter stays, because spec #1's routes contract names it. |\n| S2 | Pending-edit text borrowed Submitted's Spanish words: \"Cambios **enviados**\" and \"**esperando revisión**\". CONTEXT.md called Submitted \"the review queue\", while ADR-003 says the queue is submitted posts plus pending edits. | **Fixed.** The flash now reads \"Cambios propuestos. El líder los revisará…\". The unpublish refusal and help text say \"sin revisar\". CONTEXT.md now says submitted posts and pending edits together make up the review queue, and that the dashboard counts pending edits as *Cambios propuestos*. |\n| S3 | The `may_change_post` docstring still said \"Save, preview or delete\". | **Fixed.** It now says \"Save this post directly, or delete it\". The 403 message for others' drafts is unchanged: T02 pins it, and saving or deleting directly is still drafts-only for members. |\n| S4 | `editable_post` and `changeable_post` read as synonyms. `_pending_edit()` is a guard whose result is sometimes discarded. | **Fixed.** Renamed to `previewable_post` (it only guards *Vista previa*) and `_require_pending_edit`. |\n| S5 | `Transition.refused_pending_edit` is only set on UNPUBLISH. | **Kept.** It states the lifecycle table's \"published, with no pending edit\" condition declaratively, next to `starts`, so `move()` has no action-specific branch. |\n| S6 | Five call sites repeat `lambda: content.move(...)`. | **Kept.** Each call site names its exact Content operation. Approve and send back share the same done-or-refused handling instead of copying it. The alternative was a type switch inside `take_action`. |\n| S7 | Data clump: title, topic and body appear in `PostFields`, `Post` and `PendingEdit`. | **Kept.** Spec #1 models the pending edit as its own record. The shared surface is one `topic_name` property. |\n| S8 | `may_propose_edit` is asked in both the route and the template. | **Kept.** This matches how the templates already ask Policy (`may_publish`, `may_submit_or_withdraw`). The route decides the form contents and the template decides the buttons. |\n| S9 | Small test helpers are duplicated across modules (`text`, `section`). | **Kept.** This follows the existing convention of module-local helpers, as in T03 and T04. The one shared need, reading the dashboard counts, became a `dashboard_counts` fixture. |\n| S10 | The preview test maps to no acceptance criterion, and the T04 dashboard test name doesn't mention the new count. | **Kept.** Extra tests are allowed. The T04 test asserts the whole dashboard, and the T05 test covers the pending-edit count by name. |\n| S11 | `if fields is LINEUP` sits inside the seed's publish loop. | **Kept.** The loop already holds the published post, and a lookup afterwards would add a query for no clarity gain. |\n\n### Spec: all 11 acceptance criteria implemented, each mapped to a named test; nothing missing\n\n| # | Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|---|\n| P1 | Members can now use *Vista previa* on a proposal, which widens the preview route. | **Kept.** The editor is \"an editor with a *Vista previa*\". The test `test_member_previews_changes_to_own_published_post_without_proposing_them` covers it, and sanitizing still holds. |\n| P2 | Small extras: the read-only help text is reworded, *Borrar* is hidden while proposing, and the glossary gains Spanish names. | **Kept.** These keep the UI truthful, and CLAUDE.md asks for glossary updates. |\n| P3 | If the leader edits directly while a pending edit waits, approving it later replaces the leader's fix. | **Open question for the client.** The spec is silent. The review screen shows the *current* published version (including the leader's fix) next to the proposal, and says that approving *replaces* it. No behaviour was invented. |\n| P4 | Edits made while a post is unpublished don't set `edited_at`, so a republished post keeps its old *Actualizado el …* date. | **Kept.** This follows the lifecycle table (\"Edit directly … if published, sets edited-after-publishing\") and concerns T03's unpublish. Noted for later. |\n| P5 | T02's \"member can only read own post once not a draft\" test now covers only the submitted case. | **Intended.** Ticket #6 replaces the published case. A member's direct save of their own published post is still asserted 403 in `test_members_cannot_approve_send_back_or_propose_edits_to_another_members_post_direct_posts_get_403`. |\n| P6 | A refused approve or send-back shows the post page, not the review page. | **Kept.** That only happens when there is no pending edit, and then the review page would be a 404. The post page with the reason is the right place. |\n\n**Traceability:**\n- AC1–AC9: `tests/test_t05_pending_edits.py`\n- AC10: `tests/test_t05_dashboard.py`\n- AC11: `tests/test_t05_seed.py`\n\nEvery test name says which criterion it covers.\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1342,"cache_read_input_tokens":240021,"output_tokens":2738,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":183},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1342,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":2738,"cache_read_input_tokens":240021,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1342,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1342},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01A92XhKVqdYKLrgN6J4Ydry":{"file_path":"/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-maximo-code-iphs400-mp2-cms/e497858b-2de3-4ec6-844e-b66aa901412e/scratchpad/t05-review-comment.md","content":"## `/code-review` of T05 (uncommitted work on top of 8c8271c)\n\nTwo parallel reviewers: **Standards** (CLAUDE.md, CONTEXT.md, ADRs, SECURITY-CHECKLIST.md plus the smell baseline) and **Spec** (this ticket and spec #1). The 403 message for others' drafts is unchanged: T02 pins it, and saving or deleting directly is still drafts-only for members. |\n| S4 | `editable_post` and `changeable_post` read as synonyms. `_pending_edit()` is a guard whose result is sometimes discarded. | **Fixed.** Renamed to `previewable_post` (it only guards *Vista previa*) and `_require_pending_edit`. |\n| S5 | `Transition.refused_pending_edit` is only set on UNPUBLISH. | **Kept.** It states the lifecycle table's \"published, with no pending edit\" condition declaratively, next to `starts`, so `move()` has no action-specific branch. |\n| S6 | Five call sites repeat `lambda: content.move(...)`. | **Kept.** Each call site names its exact Content operation. Approve and send back share the same done-or-refused handling instead of copying it. The alternative was a type switch inside `take_action`. |\n| S7 | Data clump: title, topic and body appear in `PostFields`, `Post` and `PendingEdit`. | **Kept.** Spec #1 models the pending edit as its own record. The shared surface is one `topic_name` property. |\n| S8 | `may_propose_edit` is asked in both the route and the template. | **Kept.** This matches how the templates already ask Policy (`may_publish`, `may_submit_or_withdraw`). The route decides the form contents and the template decides the buttons. |\n| S9 | Small test helpers are duplicated across modules (`text`, `section`). | **Kept.** This follows the existing convention of module-local helpers, as in T03 and T04. The one shared need, reading the dashboard counts, became a `dashboard_counts` fixture. |\n| S10 | The preview test maps to no acceptance criterion, and the T04 dashboard test name doesn't mention the new count. | **Kept.** Extra tests are allowed. The T04 test asserts the whole dashboard, and the T05 test covers the pending-edit count by name. |\n| S11 | `if fields is LINEUP` sits inside the seed's publish loop. | **Kept.** The loop already holds the published post, and a lookup afterwards would add a query for no clarity gain. |\n\n### Spec: all 11 acceptance criteria implemented, each mapped to a named test; nothing missing\n\n| # | Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|---|\n| P1 | Members can now use *Vista previa* on a proposal, which widens the preview route. | **Kept.** The editor is \"an editor with a *Vista previa*\". The test `test_member_previews_changes_to_own_published_post_without_proposing_them` covers it, and sanitizing still holds. |\n| P2 | Small extras: the read-only help text is reworded, *Borrar* is hidden while proposing, and the glossary gains Spanish names. | **Kept.** These keep the UI truthful, and CLAUDE.md asks for glossary updates. |\n| P3 | If the leader edits directly while a pending edit waits, approving it later replaces the leader's fix. | **Open question for the client.** The spec is silent. The review screen shows the *current* published version (including the leader's fix) next to the proposal, and says that approving *replaces* it. No behaviour was invented. |\n| P4 | Edits made while a post is unpublished don't set `edited_at`, so a republished post keeps its old *Actualizado el …* date. | **Kept.** This follows the lifecycle table (\"Edit directly … if published, sets edited-after-publishing\") and concerns T03's unpublish. Noted for later. |\n| P5 | T02's \"member can only read own post once not a draft\" test now covers only the submitted case. | **Intended.** Ticket #6 replaces the published case. A member's direct save of their own published post is still asserted 403 in `test_members_cannot_approve_send_back_or_propose_edits_to_another_members_post_direct_posts_get_403`. |\n| P6 | A refused approve or send-back shows the post page, not the review page. | **Kept.** That only happens when there is no pending edit, and then the review page would be a 404. {"parentUuid":"518693cb-739e-4b43-9c7b-f91831c54ca7","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfvoSbss59kN2SwNdpzWa","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"T05 (#6) is done and committed locally as `faa0807`. The full suite passes (148 tests, 14 of them new), and mypy finds no issues.\n\n- **Member:** on their own published post, the editor shows a *Proponer cambios* button. Their proposal is saved as a pending edit, and saving again replaces it. A different slug is refused, and a direct save of the published post is still refused (403).\n- **Leader:** the post shows a *Revisar cambios propuestos* link. It opens a page with the current version and the proposal side by side, both as readers would see them, with *Aprobar cambios* and *Devolver los cambios*. *Despublicar* is refused while a proposal waits.\n- **Readers:** after approval, or after the leader edits a published post directly, the next export shows *Actualizado el …*. Proposals never appear in the export, even under the topic they propose.\n- **Dashboard:** a *Cambios propuestos* count links to the content list filtered with the new `?pending=1` option. Deleting a post deletes its proposal. The demo data now includes one, on Ana's lineup post.\n\n**Code review:**\n- **Spec:** all 11 acceptance criteria are covered, each by a test named for it; nothing is missing.\n- **Standards:** no rule breaches, and 11 style suggestions. I fixed four:\n  - two variable names that were confusing;\n  - Spanish wording that reused the words for submitted posts;\n  - an outdated docstring;\n  - a glossary line that disagreed with ADR-003.\n\n  I left the rest, with reasons. Both reports and the resolutions are posted on #6: https://github.com/maxillamas06-arch/iphs400-mp2-cms/issues/6#issuecomment-6111409030\n\nI changed two older tests on purpose:\n- The T02 test saying a member can only read their own published post now covers only submitted posts.\n- The T04 dashboard tests now expect the new count.\n\n**Decision for you:** if the leader edits a published post directly while a member's proposal is waiting, approving the proposal later overwrites the leader's fix. The review page does show the leader's current version next to the proposal, but the spec doesn't say what should happen here. Should approval warn, or should the leader's direct edit discard the waiting proposal?\n\n**Not pushed:** neither T04 (`8c8271c`) nor T05 is on GitHub yet, which is why #5 is still open. Pushing `main` will close #5 and #6 through their `Closes` lines.
